---
name: Feature
about: Propose new or changed behavior with acceptance criteria
title: ''
labels: enhancement, risk:feature
assignees: ''
---

## GOAL
Describe the user need and resulting behavior.

## SCOPE
Define the smallest useful deliverable and explicit boundaries.

## CONTEXT
Link the real user signal, existing flow, and approved design when required.

## ACCEPTANCE
Describe concrete inputs/results that demonstrate the feature works.

## VERIFY
Specify offline behavioral verification and the full `npm run check` gate.

## TIMEBOX
Set the session/checkpoint budget and when to report a blocker.

## FORBIDDEN
List excluded changes. No unrelated features, weakened tests, or protected edits.

## REPORT
Require issue/PR links, tested SHA, before/after evidence, check results,
independent review, human approval, and rollback.
